message.content:
Based on my search, here are the login options for PrelicenseTraining:

## Main Login Portals

1. **Student Login**: https://prelicensetraining.com/login
   - For students to access their accounts
   - You can log in using your login name and password (your login name may be your email address)

2. **Mentor/Recruiter/Company Login**: https://prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
   - For mentors, recruiters, and company accounts
   - Requires email and password

3. **Infinity Schools Mentor Login**: https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
   - Alternative portal for specific school partners

## Registration
If you don't have an account yet, you can register at: https://prelicensetraining.com/register

## Tips
- If you're a student, make sure you're using the student login portal, not the mentor portal
- Your login name is typically your email address unless you specified otherwise during registration

Sources:

2. https://prelicensetraining.com/login
3. https://infinityschools.prelicensetraining.com/mentor/login
4. https://insurance.prelicensetraining.com/page/test-drive
5. https://prelicensetraining.com/register
6. https://preclass.affordableeducators.com/
